title: Ruth Stays
paragraphs: Ruth was a young woman from a foreign land who lost her husband. Her mother-in-law Naomi, also a widow, decided to go home to Bethlehem. Naomi told her to go back to her own family. But Ruth held on: "where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God." Together they came to Bethlehem at harvest time. Ruth gathered leftover grain in the fields, kindness found her through a generous farmer called Boaz, and in time they married. Their great-grandson was David, the shepherd king. So the family of Jesus holds a foreigner who chose loyalty. God's story is wider than we think.
wonder: I wonder what made Ruth so brave and so loyal?
activity: Do one loyal act for someone, such as a card or a visit to someone on their own.
prayer: God of faithful friends, bless those who stay beside others. Make us loyal and kind. Amen.
alt: Two women walk through golden wheat fields towards the small hill town of Bethlehem.
hidden: A single sheaf tied with thread.
translation: Retold in our own words, with short quotations from the World English Bible.
